import click

def test_intrange_upper_bound_rejects_and_preserves_endpoints():
    calls = []

    @click.command()
    @click.option("--count", type=click.IntRange(1, 3))
    def command(count):
        calls.append(count)

    runner = CliRunner()

    for value in ("1", "3"):
        result = runner.invoke(command, ["--count", value])

    calls.clear()
    result = runner.invoke(command, ["--count", "4"])
    assert result.exit_code == 2
    assert calls == []

    result = runner.invoke(command, ["--count", "0"])
    assert result.exit_code == 2
    assert calls == []
